nextfest_eligibility: The game is associated with a Steamworks developer account in good standing.
The store page is published and public.
It is not a prologue, chapter 1, or otherwise a demo version of existing content.
It includes a publicly playable demo by the time the festival begins.
It releases any time after the fest concludes.
Each game can participate in only one Steam Next Fest.

discount_rules.detail: No discounts for 30 days after release (applies to both Early Access and full release), except an optional Launch Discount.
Optional, must be set up before release, runs 7 to 14 days, and cannot exceed 40%.
A product cannot be discounted within 30 days of another discount.
Spring, Summer, Autumn and Winter sales are exempt from the 30-day cooldowns and do not trigger one.
Each discount runs between 1 and 14 days.
No discounts for 30 days after a price increase in any currency. No exceptions.
Begin every Monday at 10:00 AM Pacific and run for 7 days.

store_rules.detail: New products must have a Coming Soon page live for at least two weeks before release.
Valve's review typically takes 3 to 5 business days; submit at least 7 business days before you want the page live.
Build review typically takes 3 to 5 business days; plan for at least 7 business days.
